title: Roots α and β of 2x² − 6x + 1
caption: The roots sum to 3 and multiply to 1/2, so they sit symmetrically about x = 3/2 and α² + β² = 3² − 2 × 1/2 = 8 without finding them.
alt: A parabola y = 2x squared minus 6x plus 1 crossing the x-axis at α, about 0.18, and β, about 2.82, symmetric about x = 1.5.
description: The parabola 2x² − 6x + 1 meets the x-axis at α and β.
Their sum is 6/2 = 3, so their midpoint is x = 3/2, the axis of symmetry.
Their product is 1/2, so α² + β² = (α + β)² − 2αβ = 9 − 1 = 8.

checks.name: the axis of symmetry is x = (α + β)/2 = 3/2
